recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, low-key portrait of a person with short, textured hair looking downward, rendered in a warm, grainy sepia palette with a vertical text element running along the left margin.
coreVisualRelationships: The downward gaze creates a sense of internal reflection and vulnerability.
The high-contrast lighting emphasizes the silhouette of the hair against the warm background.
The vertical orientation of the text balances the off-center weight of the subject's head.
The coarse film grain unifies the subject and the negative space into a single tactile surface.
coreInvariants: Warm sepia color cast across all elements
Subject looking down with eyes closed or nearly closed
Vertical text alignment on the far left

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up head and shoulders, slightly off-center to the right, filling approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, textured silhouette of the hair against the lighter background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top left text, moves down the margin, then shifts right to the subject's forehead and follows the downward gaze to the chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant warm-toned negative space in the upper right and along the left margin behind the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and sepia tones for shadows and midtones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre and muted tan for the background and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure black for the clothing and deepest shadows in the hair.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on value contrast; the image relies on the transition from dark silhouettes to warm, glowing skin tones.

composition.rotation: 0 degrees (letters are upright, but stacked vertically)
composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the negative space to the left of the subject

treatment.texture: Slightly distressed to match film grain

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all text to maintain minimalist aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric clarity and balanced uppercase forms.
Humanist touch that complements the organic portrait.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, sepia-toned close-up portrait of a person with short textured hair looking down. Use low-key lighting with a warm ochre background. The bottom of the frame should be dark clothing.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase sans-serif text in a vertical stack along the left margin. Use wide tracking between letters. The text color should be a dark umber to match the shadows in the image.

verificationChecks: Is the text stacked vertically on the left?
Is the color palette strictly sepia/warm-toned?
Is there a visible film grain texture?
Is the subject's gaze directed downward?

adjustableVariables: Specific tracking width of the vertical text
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist name or likeness
Do not use specific record label logos

mustAchieve: Emotional intimacy through lighting and pose

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Ensure the sepia tone is consistent across the entire image.
Verify the grain is not so heavy that it obscures facial features.
Confirm the vertical text is legible despite the stacking.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait Subject (Downcast Gaze) + Low-Key Lighting + Sepia Filter + Heavy Film Grain + Vertical Stacked Sans-Serif Typography = Introspective Minimalist Cover Art.
